featured_reviews.name: Roger Gonsalves
featured_reviews.review_text:
I traveled to Dubai with my family (wife, daughter, and son) through Angel Tours and Travels in October 2025, and we had an amazing experience! This was our 3rd tour with Angel Tours and Travels (after Vietnam and Japan), and we were thrilled to explore Dubai with them again. Our 5-day, 6-night stay at the Marco Polo hotel was fantastic. The hotel rooms were spacious and comfortable.

The tour package included delicious lunches and dinners at top-notch restaurants like Al Ibrahim, Lal Quila, and Peshwa - the food was superb! Breakfast at the hotel was also great.

Pranay, our tour manager, was extremely attentive and took great care of everyone in the family. He ensured everything ran smoothly and we had a hassle-free experience.

The office staff were very helpful in explaining the tour itinerary and clearing all our doubts before the tour began. They made sure we were well-prepared and excited for the trip.

We visited some incredible tourist spots, including the Burj Khalifa (124th floor), Miracle Garden, and Global Village. The Abu Dhabi city tour was a highlight, especially the visit to the Grand Mosque. And the cherry on top was getting a chance to attend a prayer at the Abrahamic Family House - a truly unique experience! The Desert Safari experience was thrilling and memorable.

A big thank you to Joyce mam for arranging such a wonderful tour! We wish Angel Tours and Travels all the best for their future endeavors.

Overall, I'd highly recommend Angel Tours and Travels for a well-organized and enjoyable Dubai trip. Kudos to Pranay and the team for making our trip so special!" 😊

featured_reviews.name: Harshal Kapate
featured_reviews.review_text:
We booked our Kerala trip through MyYatra, and honestly, it turned out to be one of the most memorable trips of our lives.

Initially, we were planning for Meghalaya, but due to some unavoidable reasons, we had to cancel that plan at the last moment. At that time, we were completely confused and not at all prepared for a Kerala trip. That is when Miss Pratibha stepped in and suggested Kerala as an alternative. We were hesitant, but she confidently assured us that this trip would be special — and she proved it right in every possible way.

From the very beginning, the planning was handled with so much care and professionalism. We were traveling as a couple, and every detail of the trip was perfectly designed for comfort, romance, and relaxation. Miss Pratibha and her entire team were always available on call, patiently explaining each and every small thing — from hotel check-ins to sightseeing plans and travel timings. At no point did we feel lost or confused.

The hotel experience was simply outstanding. In all five days, we stayed in five different 5-star properties, and each hotel was better than the previous one.

We stayed at beautiful properties like Hills and Hues, Rhythm Kumarakom, and Grand Cliff, and every hotel had its own charm and luxury. The rooms, the views, the service, and the hospitality were top-class. Waking up to the misty hills, lush greenery, and peaceful backwaters was a dream come true.

The tea gardens were mesmerizing — walking through those green landscapes felt like a scene from a movie. The jacuzzi experiences in some of the hotels added an extra level of relaxation and luxury to our trip. Every day felt special and well-balanced between sightseeing and relaxation.

One of the most touching parts of the trip was how MyYatra took care of my birthday. In three different hotels, they arranged complimentary cakes and beautiful bedroom decorations without us even asking. These small gestures made us feel truly special and valued as guests. It was not just a trip; it felt like a celebration planned by family.

Throughout the journey, Miss Pratibha was constantly in touch with us, checking if everything was going well and guiding us at every step. Her personal involvement and dedication made a huge difference.

From planning to traveling, from hotel stays to sightseeing, and from small surprises to smooth coordination — everything was perfectly managed.

This Kerala trip will always remain close to our hearts.

A big thank you to Miss Pratibha and the entire MyYatra team for turning an unplanned trip into a lifetime memory. We truly felt cared for, understood, and pampered.

Highly recommended to anyone who wants a stress-free, well-planned, and truly memorable travel experience. 💛🌴✨
